sentences.text: Yangfanyu is a newly described genus and species of early euantiarch fish.
The genus Yangfanyu was described by Xian and colleagues.
The study describing Yangfanyu was published in The Science of Nature in 2026.
The authors of the Yangfanyu study are Zumin Xian, Qinyuan Xue, Yingtian Zhao, Qiang Li, and Min Zhu.
Yangfanyu is an early member of the clade Euantiarcha.
The genus includes the species Y. anachoresis.
Yangfanyu lived during the Pragian stage of the Early Devonian period.
Fossils of Yangfanyu were found in China.
